newsitem.title: ESTONIA: PREATONI TO SELL MORE OF UHISPANK STAKE - REPORT.
newsitem.headline: PREATONI TO SELL MORE OF UHISPANK STAKE - REPORT.

text.p: Ernesto Preatoni, an Italian investor living in Estonia, will sell more of 2.5 million kroons of shares in Uhispank, Aripaev business daily said on Thursday.
The newspaper quoted Preatoni as saying said that as he invested the money of his friends he was simply acting under their instructions.
Preatoni has already sold half of his holdings in Uhispank.
Uhispank's share price has risen from 13 kroons, when Preatoni invested in the bank, to 49 kroons, which gives him and his associates a 36 million kroons profit, the paper added.
Uhispank's vice president Jaak Maggi was quoted as saying that it was a positive development as it would reduce the influence of Preatoni over the bank, the paper said.
